output.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_lapsed_after_2024
FROM (
    SELECT o.customer_id
    FROM marts.fct_orders o
    WHERE o.is_revenue
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
    EXCEPT
    SELECT o.customer_id
    FROM marts.fct_orders o
    WHERE o.is_revenue
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
) lapsed;
output.explanation: Counts distinct customers with at least one completed order (is_revenue = true, which is status = 'completed') dated in 2024 and subtracts those with at least one completed order dated in 2025 using EXCEPT. The remaining customer IDs are counted. Fiscal year equals calendar year, so the date ranges are calendar years.
